items.title: Edward "Kid" Ory Interview, 1957-04-20
items.q: Ben Borders was your drummer. He was a pretty good drummer wasn't he? Fair.

ctx.x: Again, with the one... Wade wasn't there. Was seeing your band, Dink Johnson, here? Wade had stayed in... He stayed in Oakland. He didn't know where to go down. Oh, you picked Dink Johnson? He was still up in Los Angeles. Mm-hmm. And he spat his feet so loud, we had to go get a mattress or bed, so he put up...

his feet. Really? Yeah. He was all pounding the drum and everyone else. Well the drum didn't record you know. Didn't record huh? Yeah. Ben Borders was your drummer. He was a pretty good drummer wasn't he? Fair. Fair. He's my owner.

I'm a bop style drummer you know. Oh yeah? Didn't have much beat on the bass drum. Who do you think is the best drummer that you ever played with? You ever had my band? Yeah. Henry Martin. Henry Martin. And the next Ed Robinson boy started out with him. Might have to pull a straw between the two of them but still I thought. They were both great huh? Henry Martin was a metronome. You couldn't move him after you stomp your feet. Couldn't make him go faster. He couldn't make him go slower. He was really steady huh?…
